acceptance.criteria: Every finding has either a completed evidence-bound repair task or a typed terminal quarantine; no unresolved acquisition, attribution, freshness, contamination, or frontier gap reaches corpus construction.

currentness_disclaimer: Acquisition and publication timestamps record when a package was retrieved or sealed; they are not a claim that the codified text is legally current as of wall-clock time. Retrieval output is a research aid and is not a substitute for the official source.
description: OUL-023 refill closure. Every source-admission seed finding and every exact-51 coverage or bucket-inventory gap is bound to a completed official-cohort repair or a typed terminal quarantine. The sealed coverage report has zero open gaps. This receipt does not authorize publication.
